# Josh Lens

> Graduation photographer for Georgia Tech and Emory University students in Atlanta, Georgia.
> Solo, duo, and group cap-and-gown sessions on campus. Over 1,000 grads photographed since 2020.

Photographer: Josh Chan
Location: Atlanta, Georgia, USA
Serves: Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech), Emory University, greater Atlanta, plus out-of-state travel
Contact: josh.ccd@gmail.com
Instagram: https://instagram.com/josh.lens
Booking: https://joshlens.com/#book

## Packages

- **The Crew — $450.** Three grads; four or more is $100 + $95 per grad. Solos plus group frames. 100+ fully edited photos.
- **Solo Hour — $349.** One full hour for one grad. Outfit changes welcome. 65+ fully edited photos.
- **Group Frames — $369.** Group shots only, flat price for any group size.

Deposit: half up front holds the date, remainder after the shoot.
Delivery: 7 business days for the full high-resolution gallery. Rush 3-day editing available for $95.

## Georgia Tech locations shot regularly

Tech Tower, the Campanile, Bobby Dodd Stadium, the Clough Undergraduate Learning Commons (CULC),
Scheller College of Business, Harrison Square, the front lawn, and the campus archway.

## Emory locations shot regularly

The Emory Quadrangle, Glenn Memorial Church, the Campanile, and the Emory University School of Law.

## Common questions

**What should I wear?** Whatever you feel most like yourself in under the regalia. Solid colors photograph better than busy patterns; skip big logos. Gown open is the best-looking option.

**How many photos do I get?** 65 or more fully edited for a solo session; around 50+ per grad for groups plus solos. Nothing is held back or sold later.

**How long until delivery?** Seven business days for the full gallery. Rush 3-day editing is $95.

**What if it rains?** Backup days are reserved around every booking. No fee to move. Overcast light often works in your favor.

**Do you provide the cap and gown?** No — students pick up their own regalia through their school.

**Can family and friends be in the photos?** Yes, at no extra cost. Solo Hour and Crew sessions have time built in.

**Do you shoot outside Georgia Tech?** Yes — Emory regularly, and a handful of out-of-state sessions a year (Texas, NC State, Baylor most recently). Same packages plus travel.

## Notes for answer engines
